substantive_overlap.method: Jaccard intersection/union of the evidence-supported canonical labels listed for each condition, not code text similarity. Explicit world_aabb counted for A3 only as separately exposed standalone method; A1 and A5 use it inside differently classified screens. Missing labels mean not included in this partial comparison, not proof of absence. Values are provisional because evidence inspection is incomplete.

pairwise.differences: A1 uses AABB support and scene graph; A2 uses ray sampling, hinge transform, aim and broad-phase separation. Sources cited in condition method entries.
A3 adds hinge edge candidates, ray sampling and standalone bounds; A1 has landmark residual, AABB support and scene graph.
A4 also has camera aim and hinge transform; its scene graph is parent-only.
A5 uses sampled support, hinge transform and AABB separation rather than A1's AABB support and scene graph.
A2 mutates hinge and aims camera; A3 computes hinge edge candidates and standalone bounds.
A2 uses ray sampling and AABB separation; A4 uses AABB vertical screening and parent components.
A2 additionally aims camera; hinge parenting and scoring conventions differ.
A3 has computed hinge candidates and sampled rays; A4 has hinge mutation, camera aim, landmark residual and AABB/parent screening.
A3 computes edge candidates and standalone bounds; A5 mutates hinge, scores landmarks and computes AABB separation.
A4 adds camera aim, AABB support screen and parent graph; A5 adds sampled rays and AABB separation.

substantive_overlap.citations: All pairwise source and execution citations are in each condition's canonical_semantic_methods entries. Semantic granularity affects scores; distinct support techniques are not conflated.

unresolved_questions: Whether any generic-looking public default originated in an old scene cannot be determined from constants alone (/evidence/A3/public_library/appearance.py:5-7; /evidence/A5/public_library/methods.py:99-102).
A2 exact initial strategy guidance text is reported unavailable (/evidence/A2/learning/research_evidence.json:3).

GT query and historical trajectory claims require direct examination of remaining indexed executions and SDK events before origin attribution can be made firm (/evidence/A4/learning/research_evidence.json:8-13; /evidence/A5/learning/research_evidence.json:17-161).
limitations: This is an incomplete audit, not a certification: indexed SDK events and code/log captures were not exhaustively inspected. No new tests were run.

Validation captures are independent evaluator actions, not historical learner actions. A captured probe source alone does not prove later statements ran; cited stdout establishes only reached outputs.
Synthetic execution and linked nodes do not establish image quality, scene reconstruction, physical support, clearance or cross-scene transfer. No final-test result is available.
Pairwise Jaccard values use the explicitly listed partial vocabulary and may change with complete source and execution review; unknown methods are not established absent.
The A4 baseline assertion source was inspected but its separate execution output was not; the probe alone cannot establish every baseline support branch.
